name: tierwyn
description: A meta-harness for coding agents — one browser UI for the agents you already run
author: The Tierwyn Authors

scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && sh -c 'for b in prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.deploy:prod:full: npm run build --workspaces && sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.typecheck: npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.tierwyn:start: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user start $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:stop: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user stop $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:restart: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:status: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user status $u --no-pager; done'
scripts.tierwyn:start:all: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web piper kokoro grokbot; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user cat $u >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl --user start $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:start:grokbot: sh -c 'for b in grokbot; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user start $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:start:kokoro: sh -c 'for b in kokoro; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user start $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:start:piper: sh -c 'for b in piper; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user start $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:start:prod: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user start $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:stop:all: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web piper kokoro grokbot; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user cat $u >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl --user stop $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:stop:grokbot: sh -c 'for b in grokbot; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user stop $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:stop:kokoro: sh -c 'for b in kokoro; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user stop $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:stop:piper: sh -c 'for b in piper; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user stop $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:stop:prod: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user stop $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:restart:all: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web piper kokoro grokbot; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user cat $u >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:restart:grokbot: sh -c 'for b in grokbot; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:restart:kokoro: sh -c 'for b in kokoro; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:restart:piper: sh -c 'for b in piper; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
scripts.tierwyn:restart:prod: sh -c 'for b in prod prod-web; do u=tierwyn-$b; systemctl --user restart $u; done'
